Recorded claim:
`commands/graph/review-sync.mjs`, `/api/review-sync`, and **Sync Review from Working...** require `SYNC REVIEW`, reject tracked Working changes with `reviewSync.reason = "source-dirty"`, then sync both `Working Gecko root`/`comm` and `Review Gecko root`/`comm`. Parent cleanup excludes nested Review `comm` with `git clean -e`; it is synchronized independently. Build reuse copies Firefox-root `obj-*` and `mozconfig*` with copy-on-write flags. [Task 1]
